title: Digital voucher access
bodyMd: A city distributes museum vouchers through an online form. Redemption is high among recipients, but a community group observes that residents without internet access may never apply. Officials agree that redemption among recipients measures use after access has been obtained, not how equally access is distributed. They plan paper applications at libraries while keeping the online route.
